title: "Pleasantness vs sound level"
description: "Relate ISOPleasant to LAeq with a regression line per location."
date: 2026-01-19
categories: [acoustic metrics, seaborn]
tags: [Visualizations]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-acoustic-metrics
#| fig-alt: "ISOPleasant against LAeq by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sns.lmplot(
    data=data,
    x="LAeq",
    y="ISOPleasant",
    hue="LocationID",
    palette="colorblind",
    height=6,
    aspect=1.5,
)
plt.title("Sound level (LAeq) and pleasantness")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
